domainConstraints.standard: Craig, J.J. (2005) Introduction to Robotics / ISO 9283:1998

invariants.physicalBasis: Metric length of rigid articulated manipulator links must be non-negative real numbers.
Payload mass must be non-negative in gravitational torque dynamics (m >= 0). Zero payload is valid boundary limit.
Joint angular acceleration magnitude must be non-negative.
Standard atmospheric model troposphere/stratosphere valid domain extends from sea level (0 m) to mesopause ceiling (80,000 m). Sub-surface altitude (h < 0) is physically non-atmospheric.
Airspeed magnitude must be non-negative real value.

domainConstraints.standard: SAE J2263 / Hucho (1998) Aerodynamics of Road Vehicles

invariants.physicalBasis: Aerodynamic drag coefficient for passive road vehicles must be non-negative. Cd < 0 represents spontaneous propulsion from air resistance, violating the 2nd Law of Thermodynamics.
Physical road vehicle frontal projected area must be strictly positive.
Road speed magnitude must be non-negative. Speed = 0 represents static vehicle boundary condition.

domainConstraints.standard: IEC 61400-1:2019 / Betz Physical Law (1919) 1D Actuator Disk Momentum Theory

invariants.physicalBasis: Betz's Law (1919) establishes the maximum theoretical aerodynamic power extraction efficiency of an open-flow wind turbine as Cp_max = 16/27 (~0.59259). Cp > 16/27 violates linear momentum and energy conservation.
Rotor radius must be strictly positive for physical turbine rotor.
Wind speed magnitude must be non-negative. Wind speed = 0 represents calm air boundary condition.
Electromechanical generator efficiency must not exceed 100% (1st Law of Thermodynamics).

domainConstraints.standard: ITTC 1957 Model-Ship Correlation Line / SNAME Principles of Naval Architecture

invariants.physicalBasis: Froude scaling number Fn = V / sqrt(g*L) requires strictly positive waterline length L > 0. Non-positive length produces mathematical square-root singularities or zero division.
Vessel buoyant displacement mass must be strictly positive.

domainConstraints.standard: ASME B31.8-2020 Gas Piping / API Specification 5L

invariants.physicalBasis: Barlow hoop stress equation sigma_h = (P*D)/(2*t) exhibits division-by-zero infinite stress singularity when wall thickness t <= 0.
Pipe outer diameter must be strictly positive.
Internal burst gauge pressure must be non-negative (P >= 0). P = 0 represents unpressurized pipeline baseline (safety factor = 0).
Material yield stress and ASME safety factor must be positive real numbers.
